Expose fenced Attention APIs over V1

codeon:
  version: 1
  authority: FWN-60
  description: |-
    Expose current and historical execution Attention cases through sanitized V1 representations and generated OpenAPI contracts.
    
    Route operator resolutions through the existing profile-owned Attention store with credential-derived actors, idempotency, version, and observation-digest fences. Keep failed execution cancellation as Attention creation only, and preserve owner readback and domain cancellation authority.
    
    Add HTTP/MCP parity, closed directive union, safe response-shape, host scope, and durable PostgreSQL intent/receipt readback coverage.
